caption: Tyler Herro scored a career-high 50 points in Philadelphia, but his last-second three didn't count and the Milwaukee Bucks fell 132-129 to the Philadelphia 76ers for their 13th straight loss.

beats.text: TYLER HERRO WENT FOR A CAREER-HIGH 50
beats.caption: Tyler Herro scored a career-high 50 points for the Milwaukee Bucks against the Philadelphia 76ers.

beats.label: TYLER HERRO POINTS
beats.caption: Tyler Herro shot 15-of-23 from the field and had 15 points in the first quarter alone.

beats.label: POINTS AFTER THREE QUARTERS
beats.caption: Herro had 35 after three quarters and hit 40 with eight minutes left to keep Milwaukee within three.

beats.text: THE TYING THREE WAS WAVED OFF
beats.caption: Herro's final shot, a game-tying three at the buzzer, did not count, and Philadelphia held on 132-129.
Despite Herro's 50, the Milwaukee Bucks lost their 13th straight game while Philadelphia won its fifth in a row.
